title: The new starter handbook
slide_intent: Give internal materials the same character as public communication, because employees encounter the brand through everyday information.
strategic_value: The green signature, gradient room and alien icon can make joining Channel 4 feel connected to its playful public personality.
demonstration: A handbook cover places the green 4 above a purple gradient room, with a black title and alien icon on the green-to-white lower field.
practical_value: Decide how much expressive color and iconography a practical onboarding cover can carry.

content_islands.name: Upper identity field
content_islands.spec: Place the small green 4 over the purple recessed gradient at the top.

content_islands.name: Handbook title
content_islands.spec: Set the title at the left edge of the green lower field and attach the alien icon to its final line.

content_islands.name: Physical format
content_islands.spec: Retain the book edge and cast shadow against the pale background.

reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram’s accompanying case study explains that playful 4mojis prevent the functional graphic system from losing Channel 4’s mischievousness.
reference_purposes.Expression: A handbook cover places the green 4 above a purple gradient room, with a black title and alien icon on the green-to-white lower field.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates this treatment in an employee handbook cover.
